Co-main, bantamweight champion Petr Yan puts his title on the line in a trilogy bout with Merab Dvalishvili, seeking his first defense since reclaiming the belt from him in December, with the rivalry now tied 1-1.
47814a54-1ab1-4c59-87a4-3b6d2a74a937@ufc.know: A title fight means a championship belt changes hands only here, not in regular bouts.
